headline_fact: Brent crude rose to $88.38 a barrel on August 14, 2026 -- up about 5% for the week -- as the US escalated economic pressure on Iran over the Strait of Hormuz, including the threat of a naval blockade of Iranian ports; WTI crude traded near $82.45 a barrel over the same period.
narration_script: According to Trading Economics, Brent crude hit $88.38 per barrel on August 14, 2026, marking a rise of about 5% for the week. This increase was partly due to heightened economic pressure from the US against Iran over the Strait of Hormuz.
on_screen_text: Brent Crude Surges to $88.38 per Barrel
